description: Adds streamline tractography from this computer (.trk, .tck, .trx) to the meshes a NeuroVue window shows, over its volumes or on their own.

paths.description: Absolute paths to tract files inside an allowed data root.

added.description: The names of the tracts added.

useWhen: Show tractography from disk, with or without a volume.
preconditions: Each path is inside a folder agents may open: by default the person's home folder.
effects: Adds to the meshes shown each time it is called; list_meshes reports them once they load.

match.contains: is not a mesh NeuroVue can open

failures.meaning: The file's extension is not one NeuroVue reads as a mesh or tract.
failures.remedy: Volumes go through open_path or add_overlay_path; convert other formats to GIfTI, MZ3, TRK or TCK first.

match.contains: outside the folders agents may open

failures.meaning: The path resolves, after following symlinks, outside the folders NeuroVue lets agents open.
failures.remedy: Ask the person to add the folder to "roots" in NeuroVue's mcp.json, or to open the file themselves. Retrying with the same path will not help.

failures.meaning: The path is relative; NeuroVue does not know which folder it is relative to.
Nothing exists at that path, or NeuroVue may not read it.
failures.remedy: Check the path; on macOS the person may need to give NeuroVue access to the folder.
